mfgFacilities.label: Manufacturing facilities
mfgFacilities.definition: Manufacturing facilities operated by the Company's subsidiaries, by major geographic area (63 worldwide, approximately 10.4 million square feet). Excludes office, research and development and warehouse facilities and contract manufacturers.

employees.label: Employees
employees.period: 2025 (2025 Health for Humanity Report, published June 15, 2026)
employees.definition: Individuals working full-time or part-time, excluding fixed-term employees, interns and co-ops; contingent workers, contractors and subcontractors excluded; Intra-Cellular and Halda Therapeutics headcount excluded; total 139,769 in 2025.

notes: J&J publishes no state or country breakdown. Regions come from two sources on different bases: (1) the FY2025 10-K Item 2 manufacturing-facility counts by major geographic area (U.S. 22, Europe 22, Western Hemisphere ex-U.S. 7, Africa/Asia/Pacific 12; total 63); (2) the 2025 Health for Humanity Report (the edition covering 2025, published June 15, 2026 at the same URL that previously served the edition covering 2024), using its 2025 column, for employees by region (total 139,769) and supplier spend contracted by region (total $32.3 billion). The HFH regions (Asia Pacific, EMEA, Latin America, North America) and the 10-K regions are differently defined and do not list member countries, so countries is null for every region. The 10-K headcount (approximately 138,200 employees) differs from the HFH 139,769 because of definitions and dates (the HFH excludes fixed-term staff and recently acquired companies).
